free_text_notes.physician_note: 80-year-old woman with type 2 diabetes, hypertension, admitted 5/1 with acute decompensated heart failure (EF 30%). Diuresed 8 kg with IV furosemide; now euvolemic on oral regimen. 5/4 10:20: Symptomatic hypotension (84/50) this morning after dose increase; reassessing.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Ambulated in hallway with daughter present. The patient underwent a colonoscopy as part of routine screening last year. The result was normal. No follow-up is required.
free_text_notes.case_manager_note: Met with patient and daughter to review the discharge plan. Patient asked to move the PCP appointment; rebooked within 7 days of discharge.
